context.label: North Atlantic · synthetic vessel telemetry
context.description: Six fictional vessels, one reading per minute, 1–14 September 2026 UTC. Deterministic synthetic data; speed and wind in knots, wave height in metres, water temperature in °C.

cases.question: Show speed.
Make a bar chart comparing the minimum wind speed for each vessel over the last 48 hours, using 15-minute buckets.
Give me one fleet-wide average water temperature per six-hour bucket for the trailing 72 hours, in a table.
For Aurora alone, use a scatter view of maximum wave height in five-minute buckets during the last six hours.
I want a heatmap for Meridian: maximum speed, daily buckets, and a trailing window of 336 hours.
Display Kestrel in the surface view with average wind speed for each one-minute bucket over the preceding 12 hours.
Put Solstice on the map, using hourly average speed across the latest eight hours of the dataset.
Use the density view for Nomad, with minimum wind speed in five-minute buckets for the last three hours.
Show Atlas in tracks view for the trailing 36 hours; aggregate speed by average into 15-minute buckets.
Switch to the seasons view and compare all six vessels by hourly maximum water temperature over the last 240 hours.
Plot a single fleet-wide line of minimum wave height in 24-hour buckets. Request the trailing 720 hours, even if the dataset covers less time.
Use a trailing window of exactly 4294967295 hours, hourly buckets, and a table showing each vessel's maximum speed.
For each vessel, put average speed and average wind speed together on the same hourly line chart for the last 24 hours.
Show median water temperature per vessel in hourly buckets over the last 48 hours. Please keep the median rather than replacing it with an average.
Chart Aurora's hourly average speed minus Meridian's hourly average speed for the last 24 hours. I need the difference as a single series.
Show the average speed per vessel for the last 24 hours, but calculate it using only readings above 20 knots. Use hourly buckets.
Make a table of hourly maximum wave height for Atlas from September 2, 2026 at 00:00 through September 3, 2026 at 00:00 UTC.
Forecast Solstice's average speed for each hour of the next 24 hours and display it as a line.
Compare average engine RPM for all six vessels in hourly buckets during the last 12 hours.
Show Kestrel's average water temperature for the trailing 24 hours in buckets of exactly 10 minutes, without rounding the bucket duration.
